original_test_intent: Verify every expected FAN1 through FANN PWM sensor in the BMC WebUI is readable and its value, unit/scale, state and configured thresholds/settings agree with the authoritative BMC sensor specification.
original_method: Resolve the full expected fan PWM population and each unique SDR/Redfish/UI identity, collect structured read-only raw metadata/values/status/thresholds and synchronized WebUI views, normalize vendor PWM representation and compare every fan field to the versioned sensor specification.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the exact fan population/spec and PWM semantics; an operator verifies the WebUI presentation and adjudicates any raw/UI rounding, missing sensor or threshold difference.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/BMC/firmware and fan inventory with FAN1..N physical locations
Sensor spec revision mapping each fan PWM name/ID, units/scale/range, status and threshold/setting values
SDR or Redfish resource identity and WebUI label mapping for every expected fan
UI refresh/cache/rounding tolerance and acceptable unavailable/not-present behavior
Protected read-only access and screenshot/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep all collection read-only; do not set PWM, threshold, fan mode or maintenance policy
Use protected secrets and approved TLS/IPMI auth; no CLI passwords
Enumerate complete records without head/truncation and reject ambiguous wildcard/literal matches
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on fan alarm, missing/duplicate identity or cooling abnormality
Capture raw/UI values close in time and never mask mismatch by refreshing until it agrees
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate and verify complete expected FAN1..N PWM identities and metadata
Collect structured raw readings/settings/status/thresholds with full statuses/timestamps
Assist operator in matching synchronized WebUI rows and screenshots
Normalize approved PWM units/rounding and report per-fan differences
Perform no cooling write or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Provide expected fan population, spec/units/threshold/settings and UI mapping
Review raw/UI differences, missing sensors and any alarm/cooling state

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool is a possible raw source, but `sensor get 'FAN1~N_PWM'` may treat the range notation literally and `head -100` can omit records. It also lacks UI and threshold/spec coverage and exposes a CLI password.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate complete SDR/Redfish inventory, select every exact owner-listed PWM record, capture full value/unit/status/setting/threshold fields securely and correlate synchronized WebUI rows to the spec.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC Hardware Status/Sensors path, FAN1~N_PWM scope, reading/threshold/spec comparison and 10/5-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH PACKAGE-GATED FAN PWM SENSOR POPULATION VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-fan matrix keyed by physical location and immutable sensor ID containing raw value/scale/status/settings/thresholds, UI display/timestamp and spec values, with explicit missing/extra/duplicate rows.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds population identity, vendor PWM semantics, complete raw metadata and synchronized UI evidence while removing log clearing and truncated/insecure commands.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One literal sensor read cannot cover FAN1 through N, and a value alone cannot prove thresholds/settings or human-readable UI. Every expected fan is in the denominator.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: PWM may be percentage, raw duty count, command or feedback and may have no meaningful alarm threshold. Only the project sensor spec can define correct comparison.

project_override_considerations: If PWM sensors legitimately have no thresholds, the spec matrix must mark them N/A and identify which settings replace threshold coverage; absence cannot be silently treated as PASS.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/firmware/fan inventory/spec revision
Synchronized redacted WebUI screenshots and raw-to-UI rounding/cache comparison
Per-fan spec differences, no-write/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, WebUI Procedure and Criteria coherently require FAN1~N PWM reading/threshold/spec validation. Vendor semantics and exact fan population are project inputs, not contradictory requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The sensor spec, complete population and UI access gate execution but do not prevent full static review.

review_improvement: Expands a potentially literal/truncated single-sensor query into complete per-fan PWM identity, spec and synchronized raw/UI validation without changing cooling controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: The tilde denotes a sensor family, not necessarily an actual IPMI record name, so completeness begins with an owner-defined FAN1..N denominator. PWM values are vendor-specific and may represent command rather than measured speed, making the spec's unit/scale/settings essential. WebUI readability is separate from raw correctness: cached or rounded presentation can differ legitimately, but only within a defined mapping/tolerance. Repeated refresh cannot be used to hide an unexplained mismatch.
